privacy_policy_avr_web_consulting.question: Does AVR Web Consulting sell my data?
privacy_policy_avr_web_consulting.answer: No. We never sell, rent or trade personal data with third parties.

privacy_policy_long_my_enquiry.question: How long is my enquiry data kept?
privacy_policy_long_my_enquiry.answer: Enquiry and audit request data is kept for 24 months, after which it is deleted unless you become a client.

privacy_policy_i_request_deletion.question: How do I request deletion of my data?
privacy_policy_i_request_deletion.answer: Email info@avrwebconsulting.com with the subject "Data deletion" and we will remove your records within 30 days and confirm in writing.

privacy_policy_use_cookies.question: Do you use cookies?
privacy_policy_use_cookies.answer: We use only essential cookies and privacy-friendly aggregate analytics. We do not run third-party advertising trackers on this site.

privacy_policy_my_client_data.question: Is my client data confidential?
privacy_policy_my_client_data.answer: Yes. Client strategies, data and results are confidential and are never published as case studies without written permission.

privacy_policy_who_i_contact.question: Who do I contact about privacy?
privacy_policy_who_i_contact.answer: Contact info@avrwebconsulting.com or call +91-9182543249 for any privacy question or complaint.
